note: Declared part of the data release manifest (data contract §2). PreparedDataStore.open() validates every asset and publishes the effective manifest (derived versions + asset_status) as store.manifest; the declarations below never override what validation finds.

dataset.dataset_version_rule: <export version>.<generated date>.<first 12 hex of sha256 over catalog/variables.json, catalog/series_index.json and the content (sha256 of every file, name-sorted) of series/>; any changed value yields a new version even when file sizes are unchanged

version_rules.catalogue_version: <catalogue_version above>+<first 10 hex of sha256 over concepts.json, products.json, refs.json, baselines.json, phenomena.json>; editing any of these files changes the effective version even if the declared version is not bumped
version_rules.region_catalogue_version: regions-<first 12 hex of sha256 over catalog/regions.json and the content hashes of geo/*.geojson>
version_rules.catalogue_content_digest: first 16 hex of sha256 over the bytes of policies/*.json, indicators.json, manual_presets.json and events/**/*.json — their own version strings are declared by the editor, so the digest makes an edit without a version bump visible in snapshot_id
version_rules.snapshot_id: snap-<first 16 hex of sha256 over all versions>

catalogue.indicators.reason: owned by the indicator work package; validated at open() when delivered

data.series.reason: monthly series-2 for basin3, basin4, named, lme, sea and ice regions; hex cells have no series

events.reason: no recorded event catalogue (flood, drought, heatwave, fire, cyclone) has been delivered; recorded-event results are data_required
